name: Yotpo
tagline: Yotpo is an e-commerce marketing platform that uses AI to collect and leverage reviews, ratings, and user-generated content. Its AI analyses review sentiment, auto-responds to reviews, and surfaces insights for product improvement. Its loyalty and SMS marketing modules help brands build direct relationships with customers.
